mapper.sql: c.id, c.tenant_id, c.user_id, c.version, c.title, c.title_source, c.knowledge_base_ids, c.last_asked_at, c.last_turn_id, t.parent_turn_id AS last_turn_parent_id FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN conversation_turn t ON t.id = c.last_turn_id
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE chain AS ( SELECT t.id, t.parent_turn_id, t.question, t.status, t.answer_record_id, t.knowledge_base_ids, t.asked_at, 0 AS depth FROM conversation c JOIN conversation_turn t ON t.id = c.last_turn_id WHERE c.id = #{conversationId} UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_turn_id, p.question, p.status, p.answer_record_id, p.knowledge_base_ids, p.asked_at, chain.depth + 1 FROM conversation_turn p JOIN chain ON p.id = chain.parent_turn_id ) SELECT id, parent_turn_id, question, status, answer_record_id, knowledge_base_ids, asked_at FROM chain ORDER BY depth DESC
